purpose: Teach: 秀逸/汽車/争っ/佳/奥行き/クアラルンプール/北上/代名詞

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんの作品、本気で、秀逸って、コンテストで、本気で、評価、されたんだよ、本気で、誇りに、思う、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Mom — Dad's work was actually really excellent. The contest judges took it seriously, and I'm so proud of him. Really, truly proud.
lines.style: Bright, emphatic energy on each affirmation. Quick pace. Six-year-old earnestness — he's stating facts he's worked out himself. Slight breathlessness, like pride is spilling out faster than words. Genuine child voice, no performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お祖父ちゃん、昔、汽車に、乗って、家族旅行、本気で、楽しんでたって、聞いたわよ、翔くん、本当に、絶対、ロマンチック。
lines.en: Yes. Grandpa used to take family trips on the old trains, you know. He really enjoyed those trips, Sho. It's romantic when you think about it, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm, thoughtful tone. Eyes looking slightly away, into memory. Slow, deliberate pacing. A mother sharing something she treasures. Soft smile audible. Gentle — not wistful for herself but for what mattered to others.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お兄ちゃんと、本気で、争ったこと、もう、しないって、約束したよ、ママ、絶対、本気で、優しくする、本当に、約束、絶対、本気。
lines.en: And I promised you, Mom — I'm not going to fight with your brother anymore. I'm going to be kind to him. I really mean it.
lines.style: Solemn, child-like sincerity. Slower pace than before — he's making a promise he takes seriously. Each word has weight. Slight formal quality, like he's said this promise to himself already. Steady eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんの俳句、本気で、佳作賞、本気で、いただいたのよ、翔くん、本当に、すごいよね、絶対、お父さん、絶対、本気で、誇り。
lines.en: Your dad's haiku won an honorable mention award, Sho. Isn't that amazing? Your father is really something to be proud of.
lines.style: Warm, deliberate pride in her voice. Slight emphasis on 'haiku' and 'award,' not straining but clear. Gentle pace. The tenderness of a mother sharing good news about someone she loves. Calm certainty underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 絵本の、奥行きの、ある世界、ぼく、本気で、引き込まれちゃう、ママ、絶対、本気で、本当に、好きなんだ、絶対、本気で、感謝。
lines.en: Picture books with depth like that — I get completely drawn into those worlds too, Mom. I really love them. I'm so grateful for them.
lines.style: Animated, genuine delight. Quick tempo. Wonder in his voice — this is a child discovering his own tastes. Slight breathlessness on 'drawn into.' Open, unselfconscious energy. Sincerity without strain.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、クアラルンプール、本気で、出張で、行ったって、知ってた?翔くん、本気で、すごいわよね、絶対、ロマン、本気で。
lines.en: Did you know Dad went to Kuala Lumpur for work when he was younger? Isn't that amazing, Sho? Your father's had quite a life — there's real romance in that.
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial sharing. Slight lift at the question — she's sharing something she enjoys telling. Thoughtful pace. A mother finding small wonders in her husband's history. Affectionate and tender, slightly dreamy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 台風、本気で、北上してきてるって、ニュースで、聞いたよ、ママ、お互いに、家、絶対、しっかり、戸締まりしようね、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: The news said a typhoon is coming up north. Did you hear that? Let's make sure we lock up the house properly, okay? Both of us.
lines.style: Practical but gentle. Calm, steady tone — no alarm, just preparation. Matter-of-fact pace. A mother including her son in responsibility without burdening him. Quiet reassurance underneath the practicality.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、優しさの代名詞、翔くん、誇りに、思いなさいね、お父さんのこと、絶対、本気で、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Your father is the very definition of kindness, Sho. I want you to be proud of him. Be grateful for him too. He really deserves that.
lines.style: Tender, earnest closing. Slight warmth on 'kindness' and 'proud.' Slower pace — these are things that matter. A mother speaking from conviction, not just affection. Quiet emphasis on gratitude. Closes gently, like a small prayer.
